Every row falls to exactly one of 23 seats. MAIN IS THE ONLY BUILDER NAMED FOR 26 OF THE PLAN'S 43 PACKAGES AND 18 OF ITS 26 PACKAGES OF MATHEMATICS ARE NOT STARTED.
